fields.display_title: This work proposes a multi-task learning framework, M-NSRF, that can jointly learn document ranking and query suggestion. A session recurrence is introduced and modeled by an extra LSTM. The authors carry out extensive experiments to verify their algorithm. But I think this work is not of enough novelty and the experiment design can be improved.
